breakdown.description: A 25% atomic-size mismatch violates the usual Hume–Rothery size criterion for complete substitutional solubility.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 25% atomic size difference violates the Hume-Rothery rule for solid solubility, which requires a difference of less than 15%. The generated specification explicitly states that complete solid solubility would *not* be predicted with a 25% difference, directly correcting the faulty premise of the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth's correction, which changed the value to one that *is* valid (8%).
